column1: # The audit guesses an owning team: the smallest team holding admin or
# maintain on the repo, after dropping bot teams by name and org-wide teams by
# size. The guess is right often enough to be useful and wrong often enough to
# need this file. A row here wins outright, and the record says so
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. Tabs, not spaces.
# TSV rather than YAML because jq is the only parser this toolchain can
# assume, the same reason tests/Fixtures/golden/manifest.tsv is a TSV.
